mapper.select: select detail_id, job_log_id, step_no, step_name, status, message, error_info, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, create_time from sys_job_log_detail where job_log_id = #{jobLogId} order by step_no asc, detail_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_job_log_detail( job_log_id, step_no, step_name, status, message, error_info, start_time, end_time, duration_ms, create_time ) values ( #{jobLogId}, #{stepNo}, #{stepName}, #{status}, #{message}, #{errorInfo}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{durationMs}, sysdate() )
